LESSON: STORAGE OF CROP PRODUCE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Storage of Crop Produce

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Storage of Crop Produce. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Storage of Crop Produce
2. Practise Storage of Crop Produce at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Storage of Crop Produce

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Storage of Crop Produce
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Storage of Crop Produce. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Storage of Crop Produce at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Storage of Crop Produce at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Storage of Crop Produce
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Storage of Crop Produce. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Storage of Crop Produce using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Storage of Crop Produce in the examples.
2. Explain Storage of Crop Produce to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Storage of Crop Produce.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Storage of Crop Produce using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Storage of Crop Produce important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Storage of Crop Produce
2. Practise Storage of Crop Produce at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Storage of Crop Produce

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
